title: Find Delay
text: Find delay between two signals, 2 inputs, 2 outputs; {Correlation window length (samples)} sets the number of samples, {Include "change signal" output port} adds chg port to block, {Disable recurring updates} selects to set stop criteria for delay and {Number of constant delay outputs to disable updates} sets the disable updates after this number of unchanging delay value. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Include "change signal" output port
params.values: Add chg port to block off (default) | on

params.name: Disable recurring updates
params.values: Select to set stop criteria for delay computation off (default) | on

params.name: Number of constant delay outputs to disable updates
params.values: Disable updates after this number of unchanging delay value computations 3 (default) | positive integer
